verdict.rationale: 1Password provides scripting/CLI/SDK automation (op CLI, Connect, service accounts) and an Events API for exporting activity to SIEM, but none of these constitute a user-defined rules engine that automatically triggers actions on events within the product itself; Watchtower only flags issues rather than acting on them. No evidence of an 'if this event happens, then do this action' automation/trigger system exists in the evidence pack.
